He was flunking calculus because he couldn't remember the equations.

Kevin tells the story of a college student in Newark who came to his live memory class and asked for help. The problem wasn't understanding, it was recalling the equations.

According to Kevin, the student called after his next test to say he was the only one in the class with a perfect score, and that he finished in a fraction of the time. He said it felt like cheating.

That is one person's story, and results will vary.

Where in your life would remembering things better make a difference?
